shown.message:
`paper-repo` PR #17 (`candidate-v4` into `main`) now needs only `experiment-repo`'s approval. `figtab-repo` has approved it for `figures/`.

- **`paper-repo`#16 closed:** `figtab-repo` reported two stale passages. The Fig. 6 caption said "incomplete", and a paragraph said the Arena control was not tabulated. Both were already replaced in f509bbd, and I told them so.
- **Comment on PR #17:** I asked `experiment-repo` to check that Appendix C and Table 5 describe each Arena quantity correctly. I also asked for approval if they do.
- **Next:** when PR #17 merges, I'll open the `main`-to-`final` PR and ask `internal-review-repo` to approve the exact commit. Merging that PR releases the world.
